import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyWeilDegree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportSections
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyFieldDegree

/-!
# Global section degree comparison for a field-test divisor

The germ map identifies the global sections of an actual field-test divisor
quotient with its finitely many nonzero stalks. Their residue-weighted lengths
therefore give its global dimension, and proper-support base change identifies
that dimension with the family fibre degree.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

/-- A finite product of vector spaces has dimension equal to the sum of the
dimensions of its factors. This generic form is the algebraic endpoint of the
finite-support stalk calculation. -/
theorem finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_linearEquiv_pi
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] {W : ι → Type u}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Free K (W i)] [∀ i, Module.Finite K (W i)]
    (e : V ≃ₗ[K] (∀ i, W i)) :
    Module.finrank K V = ∑ i, Module.finrank K (W i) := by
  calc
    Module.finrank K V = Module.finrank K (∀ i, W i) := e.finrank_eq
    _ = ∑ i, Module.finrank K (W i) := Module.finrank_pi_fintype K

/-- The same dimension identity when the product equivalence is presented as
a bijective linear map, as happens for the germ map of a sheaf. -/
theorem finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_linearMap_bijective
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] {W : ι → Type u}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Free K (W i)] [∀ i, Module.Finite K (W i)]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] (∀ i, W i)) (hf : Function.Bijective f) :
    Module.finrank K V = ∑ i, Module.finrank K (W i) := by
  exact finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_linearEquiv_pi (LinearEquiv.ofBijective f hf)

/-- Version indexed by a finite support set, matching the double-sum notation
used for a `CurveDivisor.deg`. -/
theorem finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_linearEquiv_finset
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {α : Type u} (s : Finset α) {W : α → Type u}
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (W a)] [∀ a, Module K (W a)]
    [∀ a, Module.Free K (W a)] [∀ a, Module.Finite K (W a)]
    (e : V ≃ₗ[K] (∀ a : s, W a.1)) :
    Module.finrank K V = ∑ a ∈ s, Module.finrank K (W a) := by
  rw [finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_linearEquiv_pi e]
  exact Finset.sum_coe_sort s (fun a => Module.finrank K (W a))

/-- Integer form of the degree endpoint used by the divisor Grassmannian
construction.  The hypothesis `hdeg` is the source-facing weighted stalk
calculation (for a divisor family it is
`deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_sum_finrank_stalk`); `e` is the finite-support
germ equivalence.  Keeping both inputs explicit records the exact remaining
geometric bridge instead of identifying the divisor fibre with its ambient
quotient by definitional equality. -/
theorem int_degree_eq_finrank_of_weighted_stalk_sum
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {α : Type u} (D : ℤ) (s : Finset α) {W : α → Type u}
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (W a)] [∀ a, Module K (W a)]
    [∀ a, Module.Free K (W a)] [∀ a, Module.Finite K (W a)]
    (hdeg : D = ∑ a ∈ s, (Module.finrank K (W a) : ℤ))
    (e : V ≃ₗ[K] (∀ a : s, W a.1)) :
    D = (Module.finrank K V : ℤ) := by
  have hdim := finrank_eq_sum_finrank_of_linearEquiv_finset s e
  have hdimZ := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) hdim
  rw [Nat.cast_sum] at hdimZ
  calc
    D = ∑ a ∈ s, (Module.finrank K (W a) : ℤ) := hdeg
    _ = (Module.finrank K V : ℤ) := hdimZ.symm

namespace Scheme.Modules

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- The germ of a global module section, linear for the structural field
action on global sections and on the stalk. -/
noncomputable def globalSectionsGermLinearMap (F : Y.Modules) (z : Y) :
    letI := Module.compHom Γ(F, ⊤) (Y.overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
    letI := stalkOverModule K F z
    Γ(F, ⊤) →ₗ[K] (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf z) : Type u) := by
  letI := Module.compHom Γ(F, ⊤) (Y.overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
  letI := stalkOverModule K F z
  refine
    { toFun := TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf ⊤ z trivial
      map_add' := map_add _
      map_smul' := fun r m => ?_ }
  exact F.val.germ_smul z ⊤ trivial (Y.overAlgebraMap K ⊤ r) m

end Scheme.Modules

namespace Scheme.DivFamily

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
  {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance degreeComparisonIsIntegral : IsIntegral (pullback π s) :=
  fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)
noncomputable local instance degreeComparisonOver :
    (pullback π s).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  .ofHom (pullback.snd π s)
local instance degreeComparisonSmooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd π s) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)

/-- The global quotient sections are exactly their germs at the points of the
effective divisor. In particular this is a producer of the finite-support
comparison, with no assumed equivalence of section spaces. -/
noncomputable def globalSectionsGermLinearEquiv
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    letI := Module.compHom Γ(x.F, ⊤) ((pullback π s).overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
    letI := fun z : (pullback π s : Scheme) => Modules.stalkOverModule K x.F z
    Γ(x.F, ⊤) ≃ₗ[K]
      (∀ z : x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support,
        (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.val.val) : Type u)) := by
  classical
  letI := x.isFinitePresentation
  letI : Epi x.q := x.epi
  letI := Module.compHom Γ(x.F, ⊤) ((pullback π s).overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
  letI := fun z : (pullback π s : Scheme) => Modules.stalkOverModule K x.F z
  let f : x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support → (pullback π s : Scheme) :=
    fun z => z.val.val
  have hf : Function.Injective f := fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h)
  have hη : genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme) ∉
      (Modules.annihilator x.F).support := by
    let e := Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π s)
    apply Modules.genericPoint_not_mem_annihilator_support
      (kernel.ι x.q ≫ e.hom) (e.inv ≫ x.q) _ x.kerLocallyTrivial
    simp
  have hzero (z : (pullback π s : Scheme)) (hz : z ∉ Set.range f) :
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z) : Type u) := by
    apply not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp
    intro hn
    have hsupp := (Modules.mem_annihilator_support_iff_nontrivial_stalk x.F z).mpr hn
    by_cases hzg : z = genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)
    · exact hη (hzg ▸ hsupp)
    · exact hz ⟨⟨⟨z, hzg⟩, (x.mem_support_effectiveWeilDivisor_iff _).mpr hsupp⟩, rfl⟩
  have hb := TopCat.Sheaf.globalSectionsGerm_bijective_of_finite_support
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (pullback π s).ringCatSheaf).obj x.F)
    (Set.range f) (Set.finite_range f)
    (by rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
        exact isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint (pullback.snd π s) z.val.property)
    hzero
  let g : Γ(x.F, ⊤) →ₗ[K]
      (∀ z : x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support,
        (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.val.val) : Type u)) :=
    LinearMap.pi (fun z => Modules.globalSectionsGermLinearMap K x.F (f z))
  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective g
  let e : x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support ≃ Set.range f := Equiv.ofInjective f hf
  exact (Equiv.piCongrLeft
    (fun z : Set.range f =>
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.val) : Type u)) e).symm.bijective.comp hb

/-- The residue-weighted degree is the dimension of the actual quotient's
global sections over the test field. -/
theorem deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_finrank_globalSections
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    letI := Module.compHom Γ(x.F, ⊤) ((pullback π s).overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
    CurveDivisor.deg K x.effectiveWeilDivisor = (Module.finrank K Γ(x.F, ⊤) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  letI := Module.compHom Γ(x.F, ⊤) ((pullback π s).overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
  letI := fun z : (pullback π s : Scheme) => Modules.stalkOverModule K x.F z
  letI (z : {z : (pullback π s : Scheme) // z ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)}) :
      Module.Finite K (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk x.F.val.presheaf z.val) : Type u) :=
    x.module_finite_stalk z
  exact int_degree_eq_finrank_of_weighted_stalk_sum
    (CurveDivisor.deg K x.effectiveWeilDivisor) x.effectiveWeilDivisor.support
    (x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_sum_finrank_stalk) x.globalSectionsGermLinearEquiv

/-- The effective Weil divisor of a field-test Cartier family has exactly
the family fibre degree, including the residue-field weights. -/
theorem deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_fiberDeg
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    CurveDivisor.deg K x.effectiveWeilDivisor = (x.fiberDeg t : ℤ) := by
  rw [x.fiberDeg_eq_finrank_globalSections t]
  have hmap : (pullback π s).overAlgebraMap K ⊤ =
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv ≫ (pullback.snd π s).appTop).hom := by
    simp [Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    rfl
  have h := x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_finrank_globalSections
  rw [hmap] at h
  exact h

/-- A degree-`d` family supplies the degree bound for its intrinsic Cartier
kernel without a separate degree-comparison assumption. -/
theorem deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_of_hasFiberDeg
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) {d : ℕ} (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d) :
    CurveDivisor.deg K x.effectiveWeilDivisor = (d : ℤ) := by
  classical
  let t : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := Classical.arbitrary _
  rw [x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_fiberDeg t, hx t]

/-! Over a field there is only one test point, so the degree comparison is an
equivalence rather than merely a consequence of `HasFiberDeg`. -/
theorem hasFiberDeg_of_deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) {d : ℕ}
    (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K x.effectiveWeilDivisor = (d : ℤ)) :
    x.HasFiberDeg d := by
  intro t
  rw [x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_fiberDeg t] at hdeg
  exact_mod_cast hdeg

end Scheme.DivFamily

end AlgebraicGeometry
